referenceSources.title: Iconic Auctioneers | 1984 Opel Manta 400-Sold
referenceSources.description:
This right-hand drive 1984 Opel Manta 400, finished in Astral Silver, showcases the iconic rally-inspired design that earned the model its cult status. With flared Irmscher wheel arches, a three-piece rear spoiler, and bold '400' decals, the coupe’s aggressive stance and five-spoke alloy wheels reflect its Group B heritage. The UK registration A809 BKU sits below the '400' badge on the rear, while the Opel Blitz logo adorns the interior.

One of only 12 examples finished in this rare color and trim, this Manta 400 features a Cosworth-head 2.4-litre engine, manual transmission, and just under 30,000 miles on the odometer. It sold for £112,500 at Silverstone Circuit in August 2025, accompanied by a comprehensive ten-page history file documenting its import, ownership, and high-quality restoration.
